[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: — Paste your own text (your words as the source) — (__reader__). The verses the casting arrives at (the witness, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; the reader's offering, whole):

Where you found them at?
Got 'em 'round town, could've drowned in it
Would have floated, boated, voted
Sugar-coated, loaded hip shooter
Draw for the poor, free coffee at the banks
Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «let's get it done». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at a verse that moves in pure acoustic surplus — the language running faster than its own argument, sprung off rhyme-chains and sonic torque until meaning is almost secondary to the *cost of keeping up*. What the first operator will traverse here is the bearing-cost beneath the velocity: what must the voice sustain in order to move this fast, this loudly, past Front Street and into the pit? The verse's hunger is lateral — it wants more of the same register, more crunk, more funk, more speed — and the operator's work is to locate the axis of assertion inside that lateral rush, to find what claim the voice is actually staking in the body of its own acceleration. There is a moment of refusal buried here — *none more for me, thanks* — that the rest of the verse rolls over without stopping; that is the seam. Rebekah Cranes, the source is yours.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0246"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"What was already missing there?
Requisitioned from the grid's deficit, the level had to rise past standing height
Buoyancy demands a body less dense than its medium, passage demands a hull between self and source, consent demands options pre-separated
Bitterness demands a skin thicker than contact, a chamber demands its emptiness first, accuracy demands the bone remember its socket
Charity demands the debt be older than the giver, free coffee at the ledger-houses
A throat demands its narrowing before it sounds, refusal demands a prior mouth already full
Numbness demands the nerve was open, combustion demands the mold already set
Depth demands a floor that gave for more provocation demands a silence it can crack
Volume demands the room was quiet enough to violate, passage demands the street was built before the wheel
Rupture demands the seal was holding like some age demands each prior day survived with stench demands the gland was pressurized by fear
Speed demands the ground gave no grip back, surge demands the sweetness was mostly filler
Who could get looseness demands the joint was torqued past calibration off a excitation demands a boredom dense enough to combust or a groove demands the one was planted before the syncopation leans?"}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.52,"source_H":0.857,"source_M":0.655,"transform_F":0.598,"transform_H":0.716,"transform_M":0.645,"threshold":0.524,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_Josephus","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_Choronzon","family_domain":"witness / body / elimination-survivor","wheel_side":"above-the-utterance (what it presupposes)","counter_operator":"BEAST","shadow_signature":"capture into an alien accounting register (debt/finance/legal-accounting imports); the composition speaks in a witness-cost voice not its own","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}
